about: SCION 53 source manifest and transform record. Per-frame transforms are in build/edl.json. Unused kit: quickdraw (no drawing in this film).

assets.what: the performer: a real dog in a home movie, cut out by its SAM mask on every frame used
assets.timecode_basis: dog: catalogue start_seconds 225.559 + clip.json interval start 0.2 + i/12
assets.used_frames: f000-f020, f026-f038 (turn), f042-f048 (walk), f043-f047 (folded lying); f021-f025 not used (masks swallow the shadow); f049 not used
assets.operation: mask cut (SAM polygon, 1.2 px feather), greyscale, scale 1.60, placed by its alpha centroid on x_screen = 372 + 185*x; re-timed (play 1:1, ping-pong, stepped by distance travelled), reversed (backing away; turning back), mirrored (walking toward the door), held (4-frame grain loops). COMPOSED, not in the footage: lying down (legs folded by row compression, body lowered), head pivots at the neck (look, look in, chin down).
assets.context: an undated amateur film from New Jersey, the dog greets a person in a long coat beside a stone house with a bowl on the path. The person and the place are real and unidentified; we do not name or guess them.

assets.what: the person in the doorway: the coat and legs of the person the dog greets in the same home movie
assets.timecode_basis: dog: catalogue start_seconds 225.559 + clip.json interval start 0.2 + i/12
assets.operation: hand-drawn matte (COAT_POLY in build/render.py, shifted by camera.json), top and left frame edges faded where the footage ends, greyscale, x1.25 brightness, scale 1.62; ping-pong; slid left along the score's person.x when the person steps aside

assets.what: the door: a white front door with a curtained window, swinging; the warm hallway behind it is the light
assets.film_timecode: offset of the clip in the film unknown
assets.timecode_basis: clip.json t0 + i/12 inside the clip file only
assets.operation: fixed crop (x 106-238, stabilised by camera.json), scaled to the doorway (0.92 m); greyscale with the warm gap kept in its own colour and exposure-lifted; HELD f027 (ajar) to 6.2 s, REVERSED f027>f022 (the closing swing run backward = the door opens), HELD f022 (open). Frames f000-f021 not used: the woman who opens the door in the source is in them.

assets.what: the person sitting beside the door: a person sitting upright in a sleeping bag in the snow, from a 1961 survival training film
assets.timecode_basis: clip file name gives its ms range in the film; + clip.json t0 + i/12 (derived, not checked against the film)
assets.operation: SAM mask cut, mirrored (faces the porch), greyscale, scale 0.92, ping-pong at 1:2; SUBSTITUTED for the standing coat at the score's sit = 0.5 (5.96 s), a hard cut, not a morph.
assets.context: a training film about cold-weather survival stress; the performer is shown sitting still, which is all we take.

assets.what: the hand: a hand and forearm reaching in from the right, holding a card that reads SORROW
assets.timecode_basis: clip file name gives its ms range in the film; + clip.json t0 + i/12 (derived, not checked against the film)
assets.operation: SAM hand mask + forearm extended by a brightness threshold; the card is left out; mirrored (comes from the left); scale 0.55; slid out by the score's reach (3.4-4.6 s) and, rotated -14 deg, by low (from 6.8 s). Plays at 12 fps in a loop.
assets.context: from a 1941 film whose card says SORROW; the word is not shown in the scene, only on the source monitor, where the frame is shown unmodified.

assets.operation: blocks cut from the stone pillar of the same house, laid as random stones (seed 53), mortar lines darkened, x0.55 for dusk
gravel path of the same yard, tiled with a mirror, x0.55
blurred (3 px), 16% over a computed grey dusk gradient

assets.source: drawn (a lighter band in build/render.py build_plates)

assets.what: dusk ambient and the light from the door on the porch and on the dog
assets.operation: multiplicative light field; warm fan from the doorway from 6.2 s

assets.what: a soft shadow under the dog

assets.operation: projector ticks per archive-frame change (higher when reversed, none on composed folds); formant-synthesized voice tones following the contours of "come here", "it's all right", "come in" (not speech); door latch and creak; inside room tone; paw taps per walking frame; breath on lying down; collar jingle on head lifts; wind and synthetic crickets
